checks.title: HTTP target proxy has an observed forwarding rule
checks.description: Checks an exact HTTP target proxy URL against the complete observed project forwarding-rule inventory. An exact reference establishes use. No local match is UNKNOWN because the reviewed documentation does not rule out every cross-project proxy reference.
checks.data_source: Unfiltered Compute targetHttpProxies aggregatedList plus forwardingRules aggregatedList and globalForwardingRules list, with full objects, source receipts, and exact project identity.
checks.predicate: PASS on an exact canonical forwarding-rule target reference; UNKNOWN on no observed reference, incomplete global or regional inventory, filtered/failed receipts, malformed identity, or partial representation.
checks.remediation_hint: Review the target proxy and its forwarding rule ownership.

checks.title: Backend service has a declared member
checks.description: Checks direct backend groups and service bindings on a full native BackendService. Empty membership is a configuration review candidate even if the service is referenced by an active frontend; this is not a global unused-service claim.
checks.data_source: Unfiltered Compute backendServices aggregatedList full item, backends[].group, serviceBindings[], native project identity, and GET receipt.
checks.predicate: PASS when a backend group or service binding is present; FAIL when both are empty or omitted on a complete item; UNKNOWN on malformed, partial, or unbound source evidence.
checks.remediation_hint: Review the backend service owner and attach an intended backend or service binding.

integration.collector_hook: After GCPCollector.run_jobs in GCPCollector.collect, call peaso.collectors.gcp_network_forwarding_completion_20261021.collect(self) once; the helper adds global/forwardingRules to the existing forwarding_rule envelope.
integration.dependency: When either new proxy ID is selected, include target_proxy and forwarding_rule in the GCP requested inventory; each target_proxy item is filtered by its _proxy_type inside the evaluator.
integration.installer: The existing peaso.unused_network_hardening.install calls peaso.unused_network_gcp.install once; admit only the three new IDs from this sidecar into common metadata.

unsupported_limits: Reviewed primary examples keep forwarding rules and target proxies in one frontend project, but do not establish a universal prohibition of cross-project proxy references. An unmatched proxy therefore remains UNKNOWN.
A backend service with no backends and no service bindings is an empty configuration, not proof that no frontend or control-plane resource references it.
Traffic inactivity, URL map reverse-reference absence, and cross-project backend-service or backend-bucket absence are outside these controls.
